rule_text.name: 702.254a
rule_text.rule: Acquiesce appears on some instants and sorceries. It represents two abilities. The first is a spell ability that functions while the spell with acquiesce is on the stack. The second is a triggered ability that functions while the card with acquiesce is in the exile zone. “Acquiesce” means “If you cast this spell from your hand, exile it” and “Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to an opponent, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.”

rule_text.name: 702.254b
